newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-WEAVER BANS RISE TO 42 DAYS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-WEAVER BANS RISE TO 42 DAYS.

text.p: Jason Weaver, who won last year's Ascot Gold Cup on Double Trigger, was banned for nine days on Tuesday, bringing his tally for 1996 to 42 days.
Weaver was found guilty of irresponsible riding at Pontefract, collecting a four-day suspension which activated an earlier five-day suspended ban.
Weaver said: "I am disappointed...but I am not going to cry about it."
The jockey added: "I've had a lot of success this year and a lot of mishaps too. I've ridden 121 winners and will have had 42 days off."
